sn22.55:1.3: No cassa no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti || ||
sn22.55:1.4: Evam adhimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti || || 3
sn22.55:1.5: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.55:1.6: Yathā katham pana bhante no cassa no ca me siyā nābhavissa na me bhavissatīti
sn22.55:1.7: evam adhimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti || || 4
sn22.55:2.1: Idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano ariyānam adassāvi || la ||
sn22.55:2.2: sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpam attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā rūpam rūpasmim vā attānaṃ ||
sn22.55:2.6: Viññāṇam attato samanupassati || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attanaṃ || || 5
sn22.55:3.1: So aniccam rūpam Aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:3.2: aniccaṃ vedanaṃ Aniccā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:3.4: anicce saṅkhāre Aniccā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtam na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:3.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇam Aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 6
sn22.55:4.1: Dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ Dukkhaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:4.5: dukkhaṃ viññānaṃ Dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 7
sn22.55:5.1: Anattaṃ rūpam Anattā rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:5.2: anattaṃ vedanaṃ Anattā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:5.4: anatte saṅkhāre Anattā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:5.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ Anattaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 8
sn22.55:6.1: Saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ Saṅkhataṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.55:6.5: saṅkhataṃ viññānaṃ Saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtam na pājānāti || 9
sn22.55:7.1: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto || sappurisānam dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.55:8.1: So aniccam rūpam Aniccaṃ rūpanti yatthābhūtaṃ pajānāti ||
sn22.55:8.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇam Aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 12
sn22.55:8.8: Saṅkhataṃ rūpam || la || Saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 15
sn22.55:9.1: So rūpassa vibhavā vedanāya vibhavā saññāya vibhavā saṅkhārānaṃ vibhavā viññāṇassa vibhavā evaṃ kho bhikkhu
sn22.55:9.2: No cassa no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti
sn22.55:9.3: evam adhimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti || || 17
sn22.55:9.4: Evaṃ adhimuccamāno bhante bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti || ||
sn22.55:10.1: Katham pana bhante jānato katham passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti || || 18
sn22.55:10.2: Idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano atasitāye ṭhāne tāsam āpajjati ||
sn22.55:10.4: No cassa no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti || || 19
sn22.55:11.1: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako atasitāye ṭhāne na tāsam āpajjati ||
sn22.55:11.2: na heso bhikkhu tāso sutavato ariyasāvakassa
sn22.55:11.3: No cassa no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti || || 20
sn22.55:11.4: Rūpupāyaṃ vā bhikkhu viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya rūpārammaṇam rūpapatiṭṭham nandupasevanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyya || || 21-22
sn22.55:11.7: Saṅkhārupāyaṃ vā bhikkhu viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhāmanaṃ tiṭṭheyya || saṅkhārārammanaṃ saṅkhārapatiṭṭham nandupasevanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyya || || 24
sn22.55:12.2: Aham aññatra rūpā aññatra vedanāya aññatra saṅkhārehi viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā upapattiṃ vā vuddhiṃ vā virūḷhim vā vepullaṃ vā paññāpessāmīti netaṃ thānaṃ vijjati || || 25
sn22.55:13.1: Rūpadhātuyā ce bhikkhu bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇam patiṭṭhā viññānassa na hoti || || 26
sn22.55:13.5: Viññāṇadhātuyā ce bhikkhu bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti || rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇam patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti || || 30
sn22.55:13.6: Tad apatiṭṭhitam viññāṇam avirūḷham anabhisaṅkhārañca vimuttaṃ ||
sn22.55:13.7: vimuttattā ṭhitam || ṭhitattā santusitaṃ || santusitattā na paritassati || aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati || ||
sn22.55:13.8: Khīṇā jāti || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || 31
sn22.55:13.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti || || 1-2
